soundness_flags.label: def:chart-selection, def:kstat-estimator, and thm:collision-coverage
soundness_flags.one_line: The selected chart and rational estimator are defined even when the established atlas is empty or every selected-chart denominator/discriminant vanishes; add an explicit failure symbol or total fallback and condition chart-specific claims on a defined nonzero chart.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 3.5 identifies the effect in the single-proxy graph with a proxy-to-treatment edge from the first k(ell) cumulants; Theorem 3.6 states nonidentifiability from the first k(1)-1=3 cumulants for ell=1 and describes an elimination calculation yielding a degree-two beta polynomial.

Theorem 3.8 gives a graphical generic-identifiability characterization for total causal effects with a known graph, using full-law overcomplete-ICA structure rather than a finite cumulant-depth frontier.
The paper identifies an effect in a single-proxy linear SCM using cross moments under a non-Gaussian latent confounder and gives a jointly-Gaussian impossibility result.
The paper assumes a known proxy-generating mechanism and a completeness condition, so it does not subsume the unknown-mechanism non-Gaussian lvLiNGAM setting.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make chart selection total: define chi_n=bottom when the atlas is empty or all candidate discriminants vanish, define a non-rational fallback/report for beta_hat, and state the Wald-rate clauses only on chi_n not equal to bottom with Delta_chi_n nonzero.

Prove and state an explicit equivalence between the original truncated source-moment image and the finite-atomic presentation used in Theta, including preservation of the non-Gaussian/nondegenerate source regime; this will make the legal-real fiber claims auditable independently of the construction.

After the ell=2,R=3 kill test, promote the exact frontier to a comparator chain by contrasting the finite-order beta frontier with both the 2025 pairwise cumulant method and the 2024 full-law overcomplete-ICA criterion.

recommended_next_step: Repair the partial rational-chart definitions, then advance the field-tier exact-depth kernel to Stage 0 with the ell=2,R=3 legal-fiber projection as its first mandatory decision.
